name: Melzo — Spotify Pro
author: Prashant
description: Made for Melzo, an ad-free Spotify music player. Streams and downloads high-quality audio from YouTube Music: it searches in the song's own language and picks the official recording. Get the app: https://github.com/prakha194/Melzo
changelog: Major upgrade in quality, for you all. If you like it, please vote 👍 on the Ratings issue.
